title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
abstract: arXiv:2611.23446v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compact convolutional backbones such as EfficientNet achieve strong parameter efficiency through local depthwise separable convolutions, yet two structural questions remain central to hybrid design: where does global self-attention improve recognition over pure convolution, and can repeated blocks share weights without losing representational capacity? We investigate both questions on ImageNet-1k (50,000-image validation) using controlled EfficientNet-B0 experiments. First, we show that wrapping a classification backbone in multi-scale feature pyramids (BiFPN) fails to outperform a plain MBConv trunk (69.99% - 71.81% vs. 72.86% plain B0) until paired with stage attention (73.15%). In contrast, keeping the MBConv trunk intact and inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at stages P3 (28x28 windowed), P4 (14x14 global), and P5 (7x7 global) reaches 74.02% standalone and outperforms a bit-for-bit matched plain-B0 c

translated_title: 紧凑视觉骨干网络中全局上下文与权重共享的适用位置
translated_abstract: 紧凑型卷积骨干网络（如EfficientNet）通过局部的深度可分离卷积实现了出色的参数效率，但混合设计中仍有两个核心的结构性问题：全局自注意力在何处能超越纯卷积以提升识别性能，以及重复的模块能否在不损失表征能力的前提下共享权重？我们在ImageNet-1k（5万张图像的验证集）上通过受控的EfficientNet-B0实验对这两个问题进行了研究。首先，我们表明仅将分类骨干网络嵌入多尺度特征金字塔（BiFPN）中无法超越普通的MBConv主干（69.99%–71.81% vs. 普通B0的72.86%），直到配合阶段注意力后才有所提升（73.15%）。相比之下，保持MBConv主干不变，并在P3（28×28窗口式）、P4（14×14全局）和P5（7×7全局）阶段插入轻量级的零门控残差自注意力适配器，可独立达到74.02%的准确率，并优于逐位匹配配置的普通B0基线。
tldr: 该研究发现，在EfficientNet-B0骨干网络的P3、P4、P5阶段插入轻量级零门控残差自注意力适配器可将ImageNet-1k精度提升至74.02%，而单纯用BiFPN多尺度特征金字塔包装骨干则无法超越普通MBConv主干。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at the P3, P4, and P5 stages of an EfficientNet-B0 backbone boosts ImageNet-1k accuracy to 74.02%, whereas merely wrapping the backbone in a BiFPN multi-scale feature pyramid fails to outperform the plain MBConv trunk.
